list.author: Paul Serban
list.excerpt: Avoid common pitfalls in your software engineering resume. Discover the mistakes that can set you back and learn how to turn them around to keep your application competitive and professional.
list.subheading: Keeping Your Resume Flawless and Competitive
list.title: Common Resume Mistakes Software Engineers Make and How to Avoid Them

list.author: Paul Serban
list.excerpt: New to the software engineering field? Discover what you should include in your resume to make a great first impression even when experience is limited. This comprehensive guide walks you through the essential elements to make your application stand out.
list.subheading: What to Include When Experience is Limited
list.title: Entry-Level Software Engineer Resumes: A Complete Guide

list.author: Paul Serban
list.excerpt: Learn the best practices for naming your resume PDF file to stand out in your job application. This comprehensive guide offers insights into professional naming conventions, file versioning, and special use cases such as web development projects.
list.subheading: The Importance of Proper Resume File Naming and How to Do It Right
list.title: How to Correctly Name Your Resume PDF File: A Guide to Making a Strong First Impression

list.author: Paul Serban
list.excerpt: Do you have coding projects that you're proud of? Learn the best ways to showcase them on your resume to catch a hiring manager's attention. This step-by-step guide offers insights on effectively presenting your GitHub and portfolio on your job application.
list.subheading: Making Your GitHub and Portfolio Work for You
list.title: How to Showcase Your Programming Projects on Your Resume

list.author: Paul Serban
list.excerpt: Don't use a one-size-fits-all resume. Learn how to customize your resume based on the software engineering role you're targeting. This guide provides tips on highlighting relevant skills, projects, and experience for front-end, back-end, and full-stack positions.
list.subheading: A Guide to Customizing Your Resume for Front-End, Back-End, and Full-Stack Positions
list.title: How to Tailor Your Resume for Different Software Engineering Roles

list.author: Paul Serban
list.excerpt: Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS) can be a barrier to your job search. Learn how to use keywords effectively in your resume to pass through ATS filters.

list.title: How to Use Keywords Effectively in Your Software Engineer Resume

list.author: Paul Serban
